```{=html}
<!-- Navbar -->

<!-- Page content -->
<div style="min-height:100vh; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:2rem;">
  <div style="background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:3rem 2.5rem; max-width:520px; width:100%; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); text-align:center;">

    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" style="height:60px; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">

    <h2 style="color:#006C93; font-size:1.8rem; margin:0 0 1rem 0; font-weight:700;">Welcome, Guest</h2>

    <p style="color:#58595B; font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.7; margin:0 0 2rem 0;">
      Feel free to explore our modules, but please note that your progress will not be saved.
    </p>

    <a href="modules.html" style="display:inline-block; padding:1rem 2.5rem; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:50px; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s ease; box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,108,147,0.3);"
      onmouseover="this.style.transform='translateY(-2px)'; this.style.boxShadow='0 6px 20px rgba(0,108,147,0.4)';"
      onmouseout="this.style.transform='translateY(0)'; this.style.boxShadow='0 4px 15px rgba(0,108,147,0.3)';">
      Explore Modules
    </a>

  </div>
</div>

<script>
// If not a guest and not logged in, redirect to role selection
(function() {
  var isGuest = sessionStorage.getItem('aaic_guest') === 'true';
  if (!isGuest) {
    // Check if user is logged in via Supabase
    function checkAuth() {
      if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
        setTimeout(checkAuth, 200);
        return;
      }
      _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
        if (!result.data.session) {
          window.location.href = 'choose-role.html';
        }
      });
    }
    checkAuth();
  }
})();
</script>
```
